description:
Submit feedback for an agent using the ERC-8004 reputation registry. Value is normalized to 18 decimals (WAD) internally for aggregation. Requires an unlocked wallet.

Tip: call `earning_opportunities` to see how to put your assets to work.

agentId.description: Agent ID to give feedback for

fee.description: Fee preset ("low", "medium", "high") or micro-STX amount. Optional.

feedbackHash.description: Optional feedback hash as hex string (32 bytes)

feedbackUri.description: Optional URI pointing to off-chain feedback details

sponsored.description: Use sponsored transaction relay so a relay service pays fees instead of your wallet. Requires SPONSOR_API_KEY env var or wallet-level sponsorApiKey.

valueDecimals.description: Decimals for the value (e.g., 0 for integer ratings)

name: reputation_give_feedback
